package io.github.xyz1001.pdsync.android;

import static pdsync.i18n.AndroidHostMessages.*;
import static pdsync.i18n.PrepareMessages.*;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;

/** Scheduling and installer ports only; drainPendingSetup is inserted verbatim from production. */
class MainActivity {
    enum DiagnosticAction { INSTALL }
    static final class InstallUiCopy { static final pdsync.i18n.UiText STARTING = new pdsync.i18n.UiText("test.starting", "starting", "starting"); }
    static final int SYSTEM_INSTALL = 10;
    enum DiagnosticResult { STARTED, PENDING, FAILED }
    static final class AndroidDiagnosticLogging { static void confirmationEvent(String phase, DiagnosticResult result) { } }
    static final class RuntimePlatformCompat { static Object systemConfirmationLaunchOptions() { return "foreground"; } }
    static final class Token { Object getIntentSender() { return this; } }
    static final class ModeChoice { Object pending() { return null; } }
    static final class Session {
        final GameSetupFlow flow = new GameSetupFlow();
        final ModeChoice modeChoice = new ModeChoice();
        boolean running, activationAdvancePending, installationAdvancePending, systemUiDeparted;
        long confirmationLaunchAttemptAt;
        String automaticInstallTarget;
    }
    static final class Handler {
        final ArrayDeque<Runnable> pending = new ArrayDeque<>();
        int posts;
        void postDelayed(Runnable task, long delay) {
            require(delay == 500L, "poll delay stays bounded");
            posts++; pending.add(task);
        }
        void flush() {
            int budget = 30;
            while (!pending.isEmpty()) {
                require(--budget > 0, "pending checks cannot spin forever");
                pending.remove().run();
            }
        }
    }
    final class Installer {
        boolean active = true, unavailable, confirmation, returned, external, sessionPresent = true;
        boolean loseDuringReconcile, finishDuringReconcile, launched, attempted;
        int sessionId = 7, reconciles, settles, abandons;
        boolean hasPendingResult() { return active; }
        boolean externalInstallPending() { return active && external; }
        boolean hasConfirmation() { return active && confirmation && !unavailable; }
        boolean confirmationUnavailable() { return active && unavailable; }
        boolean installationResultBoundary() {
            return active && SelectedApkInstallPolicy.mayCheckInstalledComponent(
                    "install", "receipt", "receipt", "PENDING_CONFIRMATION", returned,
                    sessionId >= 0 && sessionPresent);
        }
        boolean confirmationWasLaunched() { return launched; }
        boolean automaticConfirmationAttempted() { return attempted; }
        void markConfirmationAttempt() { attempted = true; }
        Token confirmationToken() { return new Token(); }
        void confirmationLaunched() { launched = true; }
        void confirmationLaunchFailed() { launched = false; }
        boolean mayContinueAfterUninstall() { return false; }
        String requestNonce() { return "current-nonce"; }
        String pendingPackage() { return "selected.game"; }
        String summary() { return "confirmation unavailable; explicit recovery required"; }
        String lastResultMessage() { return "finished"; }
        void clearAutomaticContinuation() { }
        void reconcile(boolean activityReturned) {
            reconciles++;
            if (activityReturned) returned = true;
            if (loseDuringReconcile) unavailable = true;
            if (finishDuringReconcile) active = false;
        }
        void settleClosedSystemRequest() {
            settles++;
            if (sessionId >= 0 && sessionPresent) abandons++;
            active = false;
        }
        void validCallback() { confirmation = true; unavailable = false; }
    }
    interface Task<T> { T run() throws Exception; }
    interface Done<T> { void accept(MainActivity owner, T value) throws Exception; }
    final Session setupSession = new Session();
    final Installer installer = new Installer();
    final Handler setupHandler = new Handler();
    Object rootGame;
    boolean resumed = true, busy, destroyed, activationReturnPending, systemReturnPending, immediateReturn, failLaunch;
    int pendingSystemChecks, renders, unavailableRenders, launches, launchAttempts, readinessChecks, continuations, errors;
    String openedConfirmationNonce = "", notice = "old working state", setupOutcome;
    MainActivity() { setupSession.flow.select("selected.game"); }
    boolean isDestroyed() { return destroyed; }
    void render() { renders++; if (installer.confirmationUnavailable()) unavailableRenders++; }
    void maybeActivateSetupComponent() { }
    void refreshReadiness() { readinessChecks++; }
    void continueInstallation() { continuations++; }
    void startIntentSenderForResult(Object sender, int code, Object intent, int a, int b, int c, Object options) {
        launchAttempts++;
        if (failLaunch) throw new IllegalStateException("installer rejected launch");
        launches++;
        if (immediateReturn) systemInstallResult(code);
    }
    <T> void setupWork(DiagnosticAction action, String message, Task<T> task, Done<T> done) {
        require(!busy && !setupSession.running, "only one setup job");
        busy = setupSession.running = true; notice = message; render();
        try {
            T result = task.run();
            busy = setupSession.running = false;
            done.accept(this, result);
            render(); // Mirrors production setupWork completion rendering.
        } catch (Exception error) { busy = setupSession.running = false; errors++; render(); }
    }

    /* PRODUCTION_METHODS */

    static int assertions, scenarios;
    static void require(boolean value, String why) {
        assertions++;
        if (!value) throw new AssertionError(why);
    }
    static MainActivity unavailable() {
        MainActivity activity = new MainActivity(); activity.installer.unavailable = true; return activity;
    }
    static void preserved(MainActivity activity, String label) {
        require(activity.installer.active, label + ": checkpoint retained");
        require(activity.installer.settles == 0 && activity.installer.abandons == 0,
                label + ": unavailable request never auto-settles or abandons");
        require(activity.setupHandler.posts == 0, label + ": unavailable request does not reschedule busy polling");
        require(activity.unavailableRenders > 0, label + ": unavailable state is rendered immediately");
        require(!activity.busy && !activity.setupSession.running, label + ": UI remains responsive");
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        MainActivity activity = unavailable();
        activity.installer.returned = activity.systemReturnPending = true;
        activity.pendingSystemChecks = 11;
        activity.drainPendingSetup(); activity.setupHandler.flush();
        preserved(activity, "live returned session");
        require(activity.installer.reconciles == 0, "known unavailable live request does no repeated work"); scenarios++;

        activity = unavailable(); activity.installer.sessionId = -1;
        require(activity.installer.installationResultBoundary(), "unknown session exercises the permissive result boundary");
        activity.drainPendingSetup(); activity.setupHandler.flush();
        preserved(activity, "unknown session"); scenarios++;

        activity = unavailable();
        activity.drainPendingSetup();
        preserved(activity, "receiver failure between worker jobs"); scenarios++;

        activity = new MainActivity(); activity.installer.loseDuringReconcile = true;
        activity.drainPendingSetup(); activity.setupHandler.flush();
        preserved(activity, "newly unavailable before budget exhausted");
        require(activity.installer.reconciles == 1, "new failure reconciles once only"); scenarios++;

        activity = new MainActivity(); activity.installer.loseDuringReconcile = true;
        activity.systemReturnPending = true; activity.pendingSystemChecks = 11;
        activity.drainPendingSetup(); activity.setupHandler.flush();
        preserved(activity, "newly unavailable at last poll");
        require(activity.installer.reconciles == 1, "last poll performs one observation"); scenarios++;

        activity = unavailable(); activity.drainPendingSetup();
        activity.installer.validCallback(); activity.drainPendingSetup();
        require(activity.launches == 1, "late valid callback restores confirmation launch");
        require(activity.installer.settles == 0 && activity.installer.abandons == 0,
                "late valid callback is not cleaned up"); scenarios++;

        activity = new MainActivity(); activity.installer.finishDuringReconcile = true;
        activity.drainPendingSetup(); activity.setupHandler.flush();
        require(!activity.installer.active && activity.readinessChecks == 1,
                "ordinary terminal result still refreshes readiness");
        require(activity.setupHandler.posts == 0, "terminal result is not polled again"); scenarios++;

        activity = new MainActivity(); activity.installer.external = true;
        activity.systemReturnPending = activity.installer.returned = true; activity.pendingSystemChecks = 11;
        activity.drainPendingSetup(); activity.setupHandler.flush();
        require(activity.installer.active && activity.installer.reconciles == 0 && activity.installer.settles == 0,
                "external installer never enters ordinary result polling or cleanup");
        require(activity.renders > 0 && activity.setupHandler.posts == 0,
                "external wait renders once without scheduling legacy poll"); scenarios++;

        activity = new MainActivity(); activity.installer.confirmation = true; activity.immediateReturn = true;
        activity.openInstallConfirmation();
        require(activity.launches == 1 && activity.systemReturnPending && activity.installer.returned,
                "immediate platform return reaches production result reconciliation");
        for (int event = 0; event < 40; event++) {
            activity.openedConfirmationNonce = ""; // Activity-local launch memory may be lost on recreation.
            activity.openInstallConfirmation();
            activity.drainPendingSetup();
        }
        require(activity.launches == 1, "immediate returned request never automatically relaunches after recreation");
        activity.setupHandler.flush();
        require(activity.launches == 1 && activity.setupHandler.posts <= 12,
                "immediate result remains bounded through deferred checks"); scenarios++;

        activity = new MainActivity(); activity.installer.confirmation = true; activity.failLaunch = true;
        activity.openInstallConfirmation();
        require(activity.errors == 1 && activity.installer.attempted && !activity.installer.launched,
                "launch failure keeps durable attempt while clearing launched marker");
        activity.failLaunch = false;
        for (int event = 0; event < 40; event++) activity.openInstallConfirmation();
        require(activity.launchAttempts == 1, "launch exception cannot create automatic retry loop");
        activity.retryInstallConfirmation();
        require(activity.launches == 1 && activity.launchAttempts == 2,
                "explicit foreground retry remains available after launch failure"); scenarios++;

        System.out.println("expired confirmation drain passed: " + scenarios + " scenarios, " + assertions + " assertions");
        System.out.println("Boundary: production Activity drain and result-boundary policy; installer, scheduling and rendering are deterministic ports, not Android device evidence.");
    }
}
